t.zh: 把二值工件的左侧边沿标出来。质检台只允许用三个元件，输入与输出端不计。
t.en: Mark the left edge of a binary part. Use up to three parts, excluding inputs and outputs.

brief.zh: 仅当某格为 1 且左邻为 0 时标 1，图外取 0。
brief.en: Mark 1 only where a cell is 1 and its left neighbour is 0. Outside reads are zero.

naiveWhy.zh: 变化大小会把进入工件和离开工件的边都标出来。
naiveWhy.en: Change magnitude marks both entering and leaving the part.

after.zh: 比较的顺序保留了边沿的方向，因此同一次比较就能排除另一侧的边。
after.en: The ordered comparison preserves the edge direction, so one comparison excludes the opposite edge.
